note: PLACEHOLDER. Every params object here validates against the published meeting_briefing manifest input_schema (additionalProperties: false, $refs inlined the way publish_experiments.py inlines them), and every value is plausible, but nobody has dispatched one. So a verdict drawn from this list is a claim about the pipeline, not about the agent. EIGHT cases, and DEFAULT_JUDGE_CONFIG.gates.minCases is 20. A corpus verdict over this list therefore resolves CAN'T SAY however the judge voted, because the floor was set from measured agent non-determinism and eight runs measure that rather than the branch. Eight is deliberate and not a rounding error: one clean baseline plus seven single-axis variations is what one change can author honestly across nine agents. Whether to grow every list to 20 or to lower the floor is still open — do not read the shortfall as a decision. Varied along: input richness, which is the axis this agent is most sensitive to — case 1 supplies every optional hint and case 2 supplies only the three required fields, so the discovery path runs long; whether the official is districted or at-large (the l2DistrictType/l2DistrictName pair present or absent, which the schema ties together); how the agenda is reached (a pasted packet URL, a prose location hint from a prior run, or nothing at all); city council against county board against school board against a rural selectboard; and big-city against small-town publishing practice, since a selectboard packet is a scanned PDF and a large county has an agenda center. Step 1b reads the official's priorities and community issues from gp-api; under the judge the dispatch names the seeded fixture account (scripts/seed-judge-fixture.ts), so those reads return the fixture's office-agnostic priorities and issues, the same for every case and on both arms. People are fictional placeholders in the house style (gp-webapp e2e-tests briefings.spec.ts uses 'Test Official'); this file is public, so no real person is named. States, cities, office titles and L2 voter file column names are real.
